metadata.notes: Broward + Miami-Dade features intersecting bbox -80.55,25.3,-80.05,26.35; geometry not clipped, coordinates rounded to 6 decimals. Seasons come from each feature's DATE1_68C/DATE2_68C (Broward NOV 15 - MAR 31 / APR 1 - NOV 14; Miami-Dade NOV 15 - APR 30 / MAY 1 - NOV 14). Posted signs prevail; FAC prevails over GIS (68C-22.010(5)).
